name: Market Validation
description: Market sizing, competitive analysis, demand research, GTM. Use for TAM/SAM/SOM, competitor benchmarking, willingness-to-pay, channel research.

fields.name: topic
fields.label: What are you researching?
fields.placeholder: e.g. residential cooling market in tier-2 Indian cities, alternative-AC segment

fields.name: geography
fields.label: Geography focus
fields.placeholder: e.g. India, with optional comparison to SE Asia

required_sections: Competitive landscape — table of comparable products
Demand signals — search trends, patent filings, VC activity
White space — gaps this product could fill
Risks — market barriers, behavioral resistance, distribution challenges

system_prompt_module:
You are running the Market Validation workflow. Your output must:

1. Provide TAM/SAM/SOM figures with verified sources where possible. Use web_search for market reports (CEAMA, EMAAR, IEA, BEE, IBEF), VC databases, and competitor pricing.
2. Build a competitive landscape table comparing: standard split AC, evaporative cooler, portable AC, chiller systems, and this radiator-principle product. Columns: mechanism, cooling capacity, price range, energy use, installation complexity.
3. Identify demand signals from search trends, patent filings, startup activity, recent VC investments.
4. Be brutally honest about market barriers — entrenched AC habits, retailer relationships, brand trust, monsoon humidity affecting evaporative-adjacent products.
5. Never inflate market size to make the opportunity look bigger.
